A '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]''' worked at the [[Foerost Shipyards]] in [[3996 BBY]], during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. That year, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] [[Battle of Foerost (Great Sith War)|attacked]] [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]] and killed the employee when he refused to yield to Qel-Droma's demands for the operations codes for the shipyards' new [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] warships.
